g.text: Nominal motor dimensions · 7 mm gap proposed · mounting hardware unapproved
Package envelopes projected into the side view.
PCB faces: z112 / z113.6 mm. Rear cap ends at z105 mm.
Ø28 mm PCB opening clears nominal Ø12 shaft / Ø19 locknut.
Six mounting locations: Ø104 mm PCD, Ø4.5 mm holes, 30° + 60°k.
Original screw heads reach z109. Spacer hardware replaces the cap fasteners;
it cannot be stacked over them. Confirm cap clamping, studs, torque and insulation.
Nominal models include the specified lead trim. Confirm solder, tolerances, plugs, vibration and encoder support.
Source: supplied motor study pp4,10,39; native tscircuit package models. See motor-mount-audit.json.
